structured.answer: A פיקדון locks your money in the bank for a set time at about 1.8% a year, minus 15% tax on the interest, and if you pull it out early you pay a bank fine the page doesn't calculate. In the example you end up with 68,270 ₪ "in today's money" against 70,000 ₪ put in, so with 2% inflation it doesn't really grow, and I don't think it's for my 30,000.

stuck.where: Calculator result rows (נשאר לכם 68,270 vs ההפקדות שלכם 70,000)
stuck.why: I end up with less than I put in and the page never says why in words; I guessed it's the 'בכסף של היום' toggle plus 2% inflation being higher than 1.8% interest

stuck.where: Red box on screen 3 about שבירת פיקדון
stuck.why: I wanted to know what I give up by locking the money, but the fine isn't calculated, so I got no number
It made me unsure whether a bank deposit is even safe

findings.what: Main result 68,270 ₪ sits next to 70,000 ₪ deposited with no explanation that this means losing to inflation; easy to read as a mistake or as a loss
The cost of locking the money (break fine) is never shown as a number; the page says it doesn't calculate it
findings.where: Red box in מיסוי, screen 3, and כמה זה עולה, screen 2

findings.what: אין ביטוח פיקדונות sounds alarming and is not put in proportion for an ordinary person
'הצגת החוקים והכללים' repeats on every section heading, so it's noise you have to read past each time
Glossary rows each repeat the same source tags (אתר הגורם המציע, פרסומת, דוח שנתי), so I had to scan them again on every row
Chart colours are explained only in a small legend above the chart, so I had to look back and forth; the grey deposits line is hard to see
Codes like TXI-03, BANK-06, TXI OQ14 are meaningless clutter
123 מחקר/מחושב/הזנה legend at the top is unclear
Jargon such as מק"מ, מוצרי שוק הכסף and ריבית הפריים is used in body text
